name: Michael Owen
window_note: recent_news covers 2026-08-22 to 2026-11-20 (13 stories). One item has only a month (2026-09).

recent_news.headline: Owen tells Liverpool striker Isak he is 'running out of excuses'
facts: Owen, speaking on talkSPORT, said Isak is running out of excuses after Liverpool's 2-2 draw at Newcastle.
Owen called Isak 'a yard off' and said Liverpool need to see the return on a roughly 125m pound investment.
Isak was jeered by the Newcastle home fans; Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola backed him.

recent_news.headline: Prime Video releases 'Meet the Owens', six-part docuseries on Owen's family and stables
facts: All six episodes stream from 28 August 2026 in the UK and Ireland, produced by Whisper.
It follows Owen, wife Louise and their four children over a year at Manor House Stables, Cheshire, balancing family life with the pressures of running a successful racing business.
Pre-release coverage (Heart, 30 Jul 2026) says the trailer leans on self-aware humour; Owen jokes about the public perception that he is boring, and his daughters say he can be embarrassing.
recent_news.note: sensitive:true because the show covers his children and a child's eye condition. Use only Owen's own 'boring' self-joke and the horses; no family or health jokes.

recent_news.headline: Owen's 2026/27 Premier League predictions: Arsenal champions, Man Utd top four
facts: Owen picks Arsenal as champions, with Chelsea the team to push them.
His top four is Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Man Utd.
He also picks Cole Palmer as Player of the Season, Haaland for the Golden Boot and Xabi Alonso as Manager of the Season.
recent_news.note: Aged badly on Man Utd: on 9 Nov they were in the relegation zone and Carrick was sacked on 12 Nov.

recent_news.headline: Owen 'not worried' about Liverpool but says 123m Barcola and other signings are not yet value for money
facts: After Liverpool lost to Manchester City (Iraola's first defeat), Owen said he is not worried and expects injured stars to return.
Liverpool were 9th with nine points from six games; Barcola (123m pounds from PSG) had no goal or assist yet.
Owen praised youngster Lewis Koumas for energy and attitude.
recent_news.note: Exact publication day not shown on the page (date approximate, mid/late September 2026). Koumas is also a Manor House Stables client per The National.

recent_news.headline: Owen says Liverpool's 40m Kerkez looks 'nervous and lost in the red shirt'
facts: Owen told TEAMtalk that Liverpool's full-back position is a real problem.
He said Kerkez (signed from Bournemouth in 2025 for 40m pounds) does not yet convince him as the long-term left-back.
He also raised concerns about Bradley's injury record, Frimpong's defending and Tsimikas's level.

recent_news.headline: Owen hands Alexia Putellas her third Women's Ballon d'Or as Harry Kane ends England's 25-year wait
facts: The 70th Ballon d'Or was held at the London Palladium, the first ceremony outside France.
Owen presented Putellas's award; Alan Shearer presented Kane's Gerd Muller Trophy.
Kane became the first English men's winner since Owen in 2001, after 73 goals for club and country.

recent_news.headline: FourFourTwo: 'The Forgotten Ballon d'Or' - how Owen won it 25 years ago
facts: Owen won with 176 votes, ahead of Raul (140), Kahn (114) and Beckham (102).
He received the trophy at Anfield in April 2002 before a 2-0 win over Derby, with no formal ceremony.
Owen is quoted as saying winning it feels better now than it did when he was playing.

recent_news.headline: Owen: 'I don't get the recognition other Ballon d'Or winners get'
facts: In a FourFourTwo interview (reported by ESPN, Spanish version), Owen said the award never mattered as much in England but he was treated like a hero in Spain.
He said he still keeps a photo of the voting results on his phone and that the win means more to him now.
Kane's win had just ended Owen's run as the last English winner; Owen remains the only Liverpool player to win it while at the club.

recent_news.headline: Owen on Carrick after 4-4 draw with Aston Villa: relegation zone is a poor look, a change might be considered
facts: Man Utd drew 4-4 with Aston Villa and went into the international break in the relegation zone.
Owen said Carrick had not lost the dressing room and the players were fighting for him, while suggesting this could be the time to consider a change.
He said Carrick's record beats most recent United managers and the squad is better than recent ones.

recent_news.headline: Owen in Bahrain: 140 horses in training, chasing glory in the International Trophy
facts: The National describes Owen as owner of Manor House Stables, Cheshire, with about 140 horses in training and Hugo Palmer as trainer for four years.

Two Manor House-trained runners, Glacius and Seagull's Eleven, entered the $1.5m Group One International Trophy; Seagull's Eleven belongs to a syndicate of current and former Brighton players that began with James Milner, who had success with horses from Owen's stable.
Owen says he will never play football again and is focused on 'selling the dream' of racing.
recent_news.note: The National calls him a Ballon d'Or winner 'at only 21' and gives no year. FourFourTwo says he was three days past his 22nd birthday; the year is 2001 (Wikipedia, FourFourTwo). Use 2001 and avoid quoting an age.

recent_news.headline: Manor House's two Bahrain runners finish 8th and 10th as Royal Champion wins the first Group One International Trophy in Bahrain
facts: Royal Champion (Karl Burke, Clifford Lee) won the International Trophy by 1 1/4 lengths.
Seagulls Eleven finished eighth and Glacius tenth of 13.
Trainer Hugo Palmer was disappointed but said they will go again.

recent_news.headline: Owen backs Pochettino at Man Utd, says he 'can't see' relegation happening and that it would rank with Leicester's title as a shock
facts: Pochettino replaces the sacked Michael Carrick on a contract to 2029, leaving the USA job.
Owen says he cannot see United going down ('I can't see it happening') and rates the squad about sixth-best in the league.
He says relegation would rank with Leicester's 2016 title as one of the biggest shocks in Premier League history.

recent_news.headline: Owen: Pochettino can revive Rashford, and United must keep Bruno Fernandes
facts: Owen thinks Pochettino's record of reviving players gives Rashford a strong chance of a comeback.
Rashford has no Premier League goal this season.
Owen says United should keep captain Bruno Fernandes, who has reportedly turned down a new contract offer.

now.role: 46-year-old retired striker (born 14 Dec 1979). Works as a TV pundit and commentator and owns Manor House Stables, a racing yard in Cheshire (established 2006, per Heart), where Hugo Palmer is the trainer.
now.media: Wikipedia's list of British football commentators shows Owen with TNT Sports and Premier League Productions (2013 to present, no end date). Also appeared on talkSPORT in Aug 2026 (Football365), BBC's Wayne Rooney Show in Mar 2026 (ESPN) and gave exclusives to TEAMtalk and Flashscore. GAP: no source confirms a TNT Sports contract for 2026-27.
now.racing: About 140 horses in training at Manor House Stables, Hugo Palmer trains. Brighton-linked syndicate owners have had six or seven horses there, three of them winners. Clients include Liverpool's Lewis Koumas and, per Owen, the world snooker and darts champions. The two Bahrain runners (International Trophy, $1.5m, inaugural running as a Group One) finished 8th and 10th of 13; the race report is dated 14 Nov 2026. They are trained by Palmer from Manor House but are not owned by Owen: Seagull's Eleven belongs to the Brighton players' syndicate and Wikipedia lists Vefa Ibrahim Araci as owner of Glacius. Glacius won the Saratoga Derby on 8 Aug 2026 (older than 90 days, context only).
now.tv: Prime Video docuseries 'Meet the Owens' (6 episodes, from 28 Aug 2026) on the Owen family and the stables.
now.contract: No club contract: he is retired from playing (Stoke City, 2013). He says he will never play football again.
now.season_numbers: No playing stats. Business numbers: about 140 horses in training; 71 winners in 2025 (Manor House newsletter, December 2025).
now.what_people_say: Owen presented the women's Ballon d'Or at the London Palladium on 26 Oct 2026, the night Kane became the first English winner since Owen. He keeps a photo of his 2001 voting results on his phone. On Man Utd he predicted a top-four finish (Aug), then said on 9 Nov that Carrick had not lost the dressing room, then said on 16 Nov that he cannot see United being relegated, while the club sat in the relegation zone. Football365 ranked him last of ten TNT pundits in 2023 and called him dull (opinion, dated).
now.liverpool_context: Anfield Index (12 Jun 2026) reports that Liverpool replaced Arne Slot with Andoni Iraola. Owen has criticised Kerkez and Isak; the sources found show no direct criticism of Iraola.

quick_context: Michael Owen won the 2001 Ballon d'Or at 22 after Liverpool's cup treble (League Cup, FA Cup, UEFA Cup), polling 176 votes to Raul's 140.
He scored both goals in the 2001 FA Cup final against Arsenal and a hat-trick in England's 5-1 win in Munich the same year.
He remains the only Liverpool player to win it while at the club, and Harry Kane ended his 25-year spell as England's last winner on 26 October 2026.

roast_past.angle: Tesco to Sainsbury's: Owen compared leaving Liverpool for Man Utd to a shop worker changing supermarkets.
Thanked Karim Benzema on French TV for moving to Real Madrid, because that freed Owen to join Man Utd. Liverpool fans demanded he lose his ambassador role.
Newcastle paid a club-record 16.8m pounds; he scored 26 goals in 71 games there. Joke about the price tag only, never the injuries.
His last club Stoke City: 8 appearances, all as a substitute, 1 goal.
At Man Utd: 31 games, 5 goals, and still a Premier League winner's medal (2010-11).
Real Madrid: 8m pounds, 36 games, 13 La Liga goals, one season. He says he was treated like a hero in Spain.
roast_past.note: Hero-in-Spain quote is from the Oct 2026 interview (plano source).

roast_past.angle: Got the Ballon d'Or with no ceremony: handed over at Anfield before a 2-0 win over Derby in April 2002.
Punditry reputation: Football365 ranked him last of ten TNT pundits in 2023 and called him dull. Owen joked about being seen as boring in the Meet the Owens trailer.
roast_past.note: Opinion piece; present as 'one critic said' and pair with his own self-joke (heart source).

roast_now.angle: Predicted Man Utd for the top four on 28 Aug; by 9 Nov they were in the relegation zone and Carrick was sacked on 12 Nov.
On 16 Nov he said he 'can't see' United being relegated and that it would rank with Leicester's title as a shock, while the club sat in the bottom three.
Two Manor House runners in Bahrain's first Group One finished 8th and 10th of 13. The man who sells 'the dream' got a nightmare race.
Owen, whose stable's two Bahrain runners finished 8th and 10th, tells a 125m striker he is 'running out of excuses'.
Still keeps a photo of his 2001 Ballon d'Or voting results on his phone.
Hands out the women's Ballon d'Or at the Palladium on the night Kane ends his 25-year run as England's last winner.
Says he is 'not worried' about Liverpool, but admits 123m Barcola, with no goal or assist so far, has not been value for money, and calls the 40m full-back 'nervous and lost'.
Became the star of a Prime Video family series where his daughters say he is embarrassing. Use only the 'embarrassing dad' and 'boring' lines, nothing about the children's lives.
